cohort: Three preterm infants born before 30 weeks of gestation and weighing less than 1500 g who developed ECC-associated PCE/CT during their NICU stay.
finding: Pericardial effusion and cardiac tamponade are rare but serious complications of epicutaneo-caval catheters in preterm infants, which, if diagnosed early and treated with prompt pericardiocentesis and catheter removal, can prevent recurrence and PCE/CT-related deaths.
